dynamic_rules.description: Avoid entering short trades in a developing downtrend without clear institutional absorption or initiative delta confirmation at the entry point to prevent entering at the bottom of a move.

dynamic_rules.topic: Trade Entry in High Delta near Key Levels
dynamic_rules.description: Avoid entering trades when delta is excessively high (> 300) near key levels (POC, VAH, VAL, IB edges) without clear institutional absorption or divergence. High delta near key levels often leads to reversals.

dynamic_rules.topic: Trade Entry in Negative Delta Conditions
dynamic_rules.description: Avoid entering trades when delta is excessively negative (< -300) without clear institutional absorption. Negative delta conditions often lead to reversals and stop runs.

When trapped participants are confirmed (e.g., trapped sellers followed by higher close and aggressive delta), wait for the follow-through confirmation before entering a trade to avoid early entries that might get stopped out.
Wait for a confirmed ignition bar (close outside IB with |delta| >= 30) before entering a trade to avoid premature entries during accumulation/balance phases.
Avoid entering trades during accumulation/balance phases inside the IB range. Wait for a clear breakout or breakdown with ignition bar confirmation.
